name: Pegu

queries.query: Pegu Bago Myanmar official cadastral parcel map land records GIS
queries.result: Myanmar's first-party Settlement and Land Records Department (SLRD) and the official Bago Region Government site were found. SLRD documents land-record/map custody and geodatabase work, but no public Pegu parcel viewer or bounded anonymous parcel geometry response was verified.

queries.query: ပဲခူး မြေစာရင်း မြေကွက် မြေပုံ GIS အစိုးရ
queries.result: မြန်မာနိုင်ငံ၏ ကြေးတိုင်နှင့် မြေစာရင်းဦးစီးဌာန (SLRD) နှင့် ပဲခူးတိုင်းဒေသကြီး အစိုးရအဖွဲ့၏ တရားဝင်စာမျက်နှာများကို တွေ့ရှိခဲ့သည်။ မြေစာရင်း/မြေပုံ ထိန်းသိမ်းမှုကို အထောက်အထားပြနိုင်သော်လည်း ပဲခူးမြို့အတွက် အများပြည်သူသုံး parcel viewer သို့မဟုတ် အမည်ခံထားသော မြေကွက် geometry တုံ့ပြန်ချက်ကို မစစ်ဆေးနိုင်ခဲ့ပါ။

officialEvidence.observation: Official Settlement and Land Records Department site identifies national land-record custody and references data construction/analysis based on departmental records and maps; the public page is not a parcel download endpoint.
officialEvidence.coverage: Myanmar national custodian; Pegu-specific open coverage not established

officialEvidence.observation: Official Bago Region Government page identifies the Bago Township section and shows a Bago District map image; it is administrative/map context, not a cadastral parcel service.
Public ArcGIS REST directory lists Myanmar boundary, road/rail, census, Yangon and other general services; no parcel/cadastral service was listed.
officialEvidence.coverage: General public ArcGIS services; not verified as SLRD or Pegu parcel custody

observedServices.observation: Anonymous request returned a Cloudflare managed challenge page. No challenge bypass, login, credentials or token was attempted.
Official Bago Region page loaded and exposed a district map image and township navigation, but no parcel schema or API configuration.
Service directory returned general Myanmar layers. No parcel/cadastral layer was present, so no parcel metadata, CRS or bounded ID+geometry query was made.
Search result identifies a Myanmar GIS map/shapefile viewing and printing site, but a usable first-party Pegu cadastral service and safe native parcel identity were not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: SLRD national land-record/map custody, Bago Region Government administrative map context, and a public ArcGIS directory of general Myanmar services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: National custodian and Bago administrative context were verified, but no open Pegu parcel geometry, native parcel identity, schema, CRS or citywide extent was verified.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: National land-record custody is evidenced; local Pegu registry accessibility and completeness remain unestablished.

qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: not ready; no safe native parcel identity response retained

blocker: The official SLRD route was protected by an anonymous Cloudflare challenge and the available public ArcGIS directory contained no cadastral parcel service; no bounded safe native ID plus geometry response was obtained.
remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was not shifted and no point hit/miss was used as an absence test. Pegu records may exist in local/offline SLRD files, an interactive route, another survey system, or an unindexed service.
nextStep: If a later attempt is authorized, continue only through an official SLRD/Bago route that exposes a public parcel layer without bypassing access controls; retain at most three full polygons with one stable native identity each.
